NEW MEDIUM BUG: paging skips a result when the exact-title article is pinned but is not in the bm25 top 15.

minor.issue: On page 0 the exact-title row is inserted at the top and the list is cut with ranked[:limit]. If that row was not already among the limit+1 bm25 rows, this drops the 15th bm25 hit. Page 1 uses OFFSET 15, so that hit never appears on any page. Repro: q=knot. 'Knot' is not in the bm25 top 40, and 'Diamond_knot' (bm25 index 14) is missing from all 15 pages. Fix: when exact exists and offset>0, query bm25 with OFFSET offset-1 (or offset-1 only when exact is not in the first offset rows). Alternatively, exclude the exact rowid in SQL (AND rowid != ?) and use limit-1 on page 0.

rca of the issue: Paging gap: Volume.fulltext fetches limit+1 bm25 rows at OFFSET page*limit. It then inserts the exact-title row at the top on page 0 and slices [:limit]. When the exact row was not in that window, the bm25 row at index limit-1 gets sliced away. The next page starts at OFFSET limit, so that row is never returned. Mitigation: exclude the exact rowid in SQL, and on page 0 fetch limit-1 rows; on later pages use OFFSET page*limit-1 when exact exists.
